quote: Some people believe football is a matter of life and death, I am very disappointed with that attitude. I can assure you it is much, much more important than that.
author: Bill Shankly

quote: I spent a lot of money on booze, birds and fast cars. The rest I just squandered.
author: George Best

quote: Football is a simple game. Twenty-two men chase a ball for 90 minutes and at the end, the Germans always win.
author: Gary Lineker

quote: Every disadvantage has its advantage.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: When the seagulls follow the trawler, it is because they think sardines will be thrown into the sea.
author: Eric Cantona

quote: Please don't call me arrogant, but I'm European champion and I think I'm a special one.
author: José Mourinho

quote: The more difficult the victory, the greater the happiness in winning.
author: Pelé

quote: Football, bloody hell!
author: Sir Alex Ferguson

quote: A little with the head of Maradona and a little with the hand of God.
author: Diego Maradona

quote: Success is no accident. It is hard work, perseverance, learning, studying, sacrifice and most of all, love of what you are doing or learning to do.
author: Pelé

quote: Playing football is very simple, but playing simple football is the hardest thing there is.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: Why always me?
author: Mario Balotelli

quote: I am Zlatan. Who the hell are you?
author: Zlatan Ibrahimović

quote: If you are first you are first. If you are second you are nothing.
author: Bill Shankly

quote: My greatest challenge is not what's happening at the moment, my greatest challenge was knocking Liverpool right off their fucking perch.
author: Sir Alex Ferguson

quote: A football team is like a beautiful woman. When you do not tell her, she forgets she is beautiful.
author: Arsène Wenger

quote: I wouldn't say I was the best manager in the business. But I was in the top one.
author: Brian Clough

quote: You have to fight to reach your dream. You have to sacrifice and work hard for it.
author: Lionel Messi

quote: Your love makes me strong, your hate makes me unstoppable.
author: Cristiano Ronaldo

quote: I prefer to win 5-4 than 1-0.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: Take the ball, pass the ball.
author: Pep Guardiola

quote: I'm not the Special One anymore. I should be called the Only One.
author: José Mourinho

quote: The ball is round, the game lasts ninety minutes, and everything else is just theory.
author: Sepp Herberger

quote: After the game is before the game.
author: Sepp Herberger

quote: Everything I know about morality and the obligations of men, I owe it to football.
author: Albert Camus

quote: In football, the worst blindness is only seeing the ball.
author: Nelson Falcão Rodrigues

quote: I am a heavy metal man, Arsène Wenger is like an orchestra.
author: Jürgen Klopp

quote: It was not important how they played, it was important that we won.
author: Franz Beckenbauer

quote: I learned all about life with a ball at my feet.
author: Ronaldinho

quote: To win you have to score one more goal than your opponent.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: When you play a match, it is statistically proven that players actually have the ball 3 minutes on average. So, the most important thing is: what do you do during those 87 minutes when you do not have the ball. That is what determines whether you're a good player or not.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: I never tried to hide the fact that it is my intention to become the best.
author: Cristiano Ronaldo

quote: You can't win anything with kids.
author: Alan Hansen

quote: We must have a pie.
author: Gordon Strachan

quote: If you're in the penalty area and don't know what to do with the ball, put it in the net and we'll discuss the options later.
author: Bob Paisley

quote: I've never seen a player who could dribble like him. When he got the ball, the stadium held its breath.
author: Bobby Charlton (on George Best)

quote: First the man, then the ball.
author: Nobby Stiles

quote: If I had to walk on water, my critics would say it's because I can't swim.
author: Berti Vogts

quote: Football is like chess, only without the dice.
author: Lukas Podolski

quote: I always say that if you don't shoot, you can't score.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: Italy can't lose to a team from a country where football is not the number one sport.
author: Gianluca Vialli

quote: One thing is for sure: a World Cup without me is nothing to watch.
author: Zlatan Ibrahimović

quote: I came like a king, left like a legend.
author: Zlatan Ibrahimović

quote: I don't believe in luck. I believe in preparation.
author: Bobby Robson

quote: What is a club in any case? Not the buildings or the directors or the people who are paid to represent it. It's the noise, the passion, the feeling of belonging, the pride in your city.
author: Sir Bobby Robson

quote: When you start supporting a football club, you don't support it because of the trophies, or a player, or history, you support it because you found yourself somewhere there; found a place where you belong.
author: Dennis Bergkamp

quote: Behind every kick of the ball there has to be a thought.
author: Dennis Bergkamp

quote: If you can't support us when we lose or draw, don't support us when we win.
author: Bill Shankly

quote: Liverpool was made for me and I was made for Liverpool.
author: Bill Shankly

quote: The trouble with referees is that they know the rules, but they do not know the game.
author: Bill Shankly

quote: Aim for the sky and you'll reach the ceiling. Aim for the ceiling and you'll stay on the floor.
author: Bill Shankly

quote: Rome wasn't built in a day. But I wasn't on that particular job.
author: Brian Clough

quote: If God had wanted us to play football in the clouds, he'd have put grass up there.
author: Brian Clough

quote: We talk about it for twenty minutes and then we decide I was right.
author: Brian Clough

quote: I'm not saying we're going to win the league, I'm just saying we're not going to lose it.
author: Kevin Keegan

quote: I would love it if we beat them. Love it!
author: Kevin Keegan

quote: Attack wins you games, defence wins you titles.
author: Sir Alex Ferguson

quote: The work of a team should always embrace a great player but the great player must always work.
author: Sir Alex Ferguson

quote: I used to say to the players, 'If you're going to lose, lose going forward.'
author: Sir Matt Busby

quote: If you're good enough, you're old enough.
author: Sir Matt Busby

quote: A goal is not just a goal; it is a piece of art.
author: Pelé

quote: Everything is practice.
author: Pelé

quote: The secret is to believe in your dreams; in your potential that you can be like your star, keep searching, keep believing and don't lose faith in yourself.
author: Neymar Jr.

quote: There is no pressure when you are making a dream come true.
author: Neymar Jr.

quote: I don't have time for hobbies. At the end of the day, I treat my job as a hobby. It's something I love doing.
author: David Beckham

quote: I always want more. Whether it's a goal, or winning a game, I'm never satisfied.
author: Lionel Messi

quote: Money is not a motivating factor. My motivation comes from playing the game I love.
author: Lionel Messi

quote: I start early and I stay late, day after day, year after year. It took me 17 years and 114 days to become an overnight success.
author: Lionel Messi

quote: Talent without working hard is nothing.
author: Cristiano Ronaldo

quote: If you don't believe you are the best, then you will never achieve all that you are capable of.
author: Cristiano Ronaldo

quote: We are the famous CFC, and we don't care what anyone says.
author: Frank Lampard

quote: If you don't jump to clear the ball, you don't even deserve to wear the shirt.
author: Carles Puyol

quote: You have to show respect to everyone, but fear no one.
author: Thierry Henry

quote: Sometimes in football you have to score goals.
author: Thierry Henry

quote: When you win, you don't get carried away. But if you go step by step, with confidence, you can go far.
author: Diego Maradona

quote: To see the ball, to run after it, makes me the happiest man in the world.
author: Diego Maradona

quote: In my head, I am the best. If I don't think that, I cannot be the best.
author: Zinedine Zidane

quote: I once cried because I had no shoes to play football with my friends, but one day I saw a man who had no feet, and I realized how rich I am.
author: Zinedine Zidane

quote: Football is played with the head. Your feet are just the tools.
author: Andrea Pirlo

quote: I don't feel pressure. I don't give a toss about it. I spent the afternoon of Sunday, 9 July 2006 in Berlin sleeping and playing the PlayStation. In the evening, I went out and won the World Cup.
author: Andrea Pirlo

quote: Football is a game of mistakes. Whoever makes the fewest mistakes wins.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: Quality without results is pointless. Results without quality is boring.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: If we have the ball, the opponent can't score.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: Why couldn't you beat a richer club? I've never seen a bag of money score a goal.
author: Johan Cruyff

quote: The best decisions aren't made with your mind, but with your instinct.
author: Lionel Messi

quote: I'm not a perfectionist, but I like to feel that things are done well.
author: Cristiano Ronaldo

quote: Individual commitment to a group effort—that is what makes a team work, a company work, a society work, a civilization work.
author: Vicente del Bosque (on Spain's World Cup win)

quote: It is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent, but the one most responsive to change.
author: Arsène Wenger (quoting Darwin on football)

quote: If you eat caviar every day it's difficult to return to sausages.
author: Arsène Wenger

quote: A football match is a ballet in which the ball is the prima ballerina.
author: Dmitri Shostakovich

quote: I think the English game is the best in the world because of the passion of the fans.
author: Eric Cantona

quote: You can change your wife, your politics, your religion, but never, never can you change your favourite football team.
author: Eric Cantona

quote: I don't study my opponents. They should study me.
author: Romário

quote: When I was born, the man upstairs pointed to me and said: 'That's the guy.'
author: Romário

quote: Form is temporary, class is permanent.
author: Bill Shankly

quote: Keep your eyes on the stars and your feet on the ground.
author: Sir Bobby Charlton

quote: The secret of football is to make the ball do the work.
author: Sir Alf Ramsey

quote: Never give up. Today is hard, tomorrow will be worse, but the day after tomorrow will be sunshine.
author: Pep Guardiola (used in team talks)

quote: Football is an art, like dancing is an art - but only when it's well done does it become an art.
author: Arsène Wenger

quote: The beauty of the game is its unpredictability. Anything can happen in 90 minutes.
author: Pelé
